SEARCH
Package domain

Class DOPOSoccer

java.lang.Object
domain.DOPOSoccer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class DOPOSoccer extends Object implements Serializable
Facade of the domain: the only class the interface talks to (Facade pattern). Arcade works player vs player and player vs machine, by time, by goals or in survival (only against the machine); the tournament (8 teams against the machine) works by time or by goals; and the store (points, characters, balls and stats). The profiles of both players are saved in a fixed progress file every time they change, and loaded when the game opens. A game being played is saved whole in a file chosen by the user (saveGame(java.io.File)) and opened again as a new object (openGame(java.io.File)); the profiles and the settings are not part of it. The public methods keep the signatures of the full version.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Elian Ibarra, Oscar Poveda

  • Method Details

    • newGame

      public void newGame(String modality, String aiProfile, String resolution, String modeName, String leftCharacter, String rightCharacter, String matchType, int amount) throws DOPOSoccerException
      Validates the choices and prepares the game. Arcade is played player vs player or against the machine; the tournament is played against the machine, with 7 rivals drawn at random. Both are played by time or by goals; survival is played only in Arcade against the machine.
      Parameters:
      modality - "PVP" or "PVM"
      aiProfile - "CLUMSY", "OFFENSIVE", "DEFENSIVE" or "EXPERT"; not used in player vs player
      resolution - "SMALL", "MEDIUM" or "LARGE"
      modeName - "ARCADE" or "TOURNAMENT"
      leftCharacter - country of the left player
      rightCharacter - country of the right player (not used in the tournament)
      matchType - "TIME", "GOALS" or "SURVIVAL"
      amount - minutes of the match or goals to win (not used in survival)
      Throws:
      DOPOSoccerException - UNKNOWN_MODALITY, UNKNOWN_MODE, UNKNOWN_CHARACTER, CHARACTER_LOCKED, UNKNOWN_AI_PROFILE, UNKNOWN_MATCH_TYPE, UNKNOWN_RESOLUTION, INVALID_MINUTES, INVALID_GOAL_TARGET, INVALID_TOURNAMENT_TYPE or SURVIVAL_ONLY_PVM

    • update

      public void update(double dt)
      Advances the game one tick if it is not paused. When the match ends, it computes the points. Without a game it does nothing.
      Parameters:
      dt - elapsed time, in seconds

    • saveProgress

      public void saveProgress() throws DOPOSoccerException
      Saves the progress in the progress file, which is always the same (the player doesn't choose it): the profiles of both players (points, purchases, upgrades and selected ball). The file is written again every time it is called.
      Throws:
      DOPOSoccerException - SAVE_FAILED if the file cannot be written

    • loadProgress

      public void loadProgress() throws DOPOSoccerException
      Loads the profiles saved in the progress file. If the file cannot be read, the current profiles are kept as they were.
      Throws:
      DOPOSoccerException - LOAD_FAILED if the file cannot be read or is damaged

    • saveGame

      public void saveGame(File file) throws DOPOSoccerException
      Saves the whole game in a file chosen by the user: the catalogs, the mode with its match (players, ball, score, time, effects, stadium), the tournament, the modality and the points of the last match. Not saved (transient): the physics world of the library, rebuilt from the entities on the first step; the profiles, which are in the progress file; and the settings.
      Parameters:
      file - file chosen by the user
      Throws:
      DOPOSoccerException - GAME_NOT_STARTED, GAME_OVER if the mode already ended, or GAME_SAVE_FAILED if the file cannot be written

    • openGame

      public static DOPOSoccer openGame(File file) throws DOPOSoccerException
      Opens a game saved with saveGame(File) as a new object, paused, so the player resumes it. Its profiles are loaded from its progress file (the newest ones, not the ones of the moment it was saved) and its settings are the default ones. The interface replaces its game with the returned one.
      Parameters:
      file - file chosen by the user
      Returns:
      the opened game
      Throws:
      DOPOSoccerException - GAME_OPEN_FAILED if the file is not a saved game or is damaged; LOAD_FAILED if the progress file is damaged

    • givePoints

      private void givePoints()
      Gives 100 points to the winner and 25 to the loser and keeps them in their profiles, to spend them in the store. Against the machine only player 1 gets points. The champion of a tournament also wins the prize. They are kept in the progress file when the interface calls saveProgress().
